decision.orphan_lock_gate: ArchiveWriterLock writes only PID to .jsonl.lock; a crash leaves it, blocking both load_observations and append_observations until TimeoutError. PID alone cannot safely authorize automatic stale-lock removal (PID reuse/host ambiguity). Require a documented operator-only, fail-closed recovery with proof no live owner and archive JSONL integrity before lock removal; never auto-delete unknown lock.
